description: This file defines a React component for a Next.js frontend application related to a 'Professional Persona Builder'. It handles user interactions, document uploads, persona data management, draft generation via API calls, and UI rendering for an AI-powered persona creation workflow.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts input data to an array of strings.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON string safely, handling errors.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable error message from an error object.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a person's name.

methods.name: inferDraftFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Creates draft persona data based on orchestration record.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Converts backend JSON data into the persona data format.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the persona creation and display workflow.
